g.text: A conv with stride = kernel is a linear layer
the same 768 multiplies and adds, written two ways
the window never moves inside a patch, so the conv is one dot product per output channel
that is exactly a linear layer applied to the flattened patch
writing it as a conv only saves you from slicing the image yourself, the arithmetic is identical
stride = kernel is what makes it true, overlap would make it a real convolution again
